thread:
nora-pm: Dropped a compact rules-canvas variant in Figma: https://figma.com/file/ZZZZ. Can we do a quick async pass on priorities, validation copy, and preview? :wave:

eli-designer: Compact cards look clean. Two things: make priority numbers persist (for runbook references) and expose a quick inline validation state so users don't have to open the editor.

tess-ux: Inline validation is great. Short label: "No matches". Hover tooltip: "This rule currently matches no requests. Refine conditions or move lower. Examples: ..."

mike-fe: Perf note: avoid rendering full condition lists in the compact view. We can render a collapsed snippet and expand on demand. For reorder, prefer lift/drop model (Space to pick up, Up/Down to move, Space to drop) to keep DOM churn low.

hana-a11y: Accessibility checklist:
- Priority badge contrast 4.5:1
- Announce reorder ops: "Rule 4 moved to position 2" via aria-live
- When a rule is removed, announce: "Rule X removed"
- Tooltip and modal must be keyboard-dismissable with Esc

nora-pm: Copy question: current toast says "Invalid rule". Propose: Toast: "Rule won't match any traffic 12 check conditions or remove." Inline badge: "No matches". Agree?

eli-designer: Agree. Inline short, toast long. Add a small `i` icon that opens examples in a modal.

mike-fe: API alignment: propose fields `validation_state`: `ok|warn|error`, `validation_code`: string (`no_match`), and `pinned`: boolean. Also add `sampled_estimate` for preview costs.

tess-ux: Preview simulation: show top 3 matches with short provenance (clause + snippet) and a copy button for the sim summary. Clicking a match should highlight the rule in the canvas and shift focus there.

hana-a11y: When highlighting from preview, move focus to the rule and add `aria-describedby` linking the preview card text. Ensure highlight is not color-only (outline + background). Also announce: "Preview complete: 12 tested, 3 matched. Top match: rule #2."

sim-bot: sim-bot: sample run 2026-04-02T09:12:00Z - 30 requests sampled - matches 3 - top: rule #2 (header contains "Internal-Service").

mike-fe: Note: token-cost estimates must be labelled "sampled estimate". Full corpus estimates are too expensive. We'll return sampled_estimate: true in the sim response.

nora-pm: Action items: eli update Figma with inline badge + `i` icon; mike to draft API props and keyboard patterns; hana to write a short a11y checklist for the PR; tess to write the modal microcopy. I'll collate and ping for a 10m sync if anything blocks. Thanks! :heart:
